text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the representatives for the next 
Inter-Dorm competition were announced, 
huh? Let's see here...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san... you've been chosen, um. It's 
a 5-person team match, and the others 
are... —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: O-Orfèvre-san is there too...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it was a lottery draw, after all. 
The contest is... a "Blind Carrot Tasting 
Showdown", huh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... We really need to prepare properly 
for this. I'll go call everyone and start 
special training!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Orfèvre-san stated that she has no 
interest in participating, so she won't be 
attending.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhhhh! I mean, I totally saw it 
coming! But I was an idiot for getting my 
hopes up!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
The blind carrot taste test is a 1v1 team 
battle... So one of us taking an automatic 
forfeit is guaranteed, huh... That's 
rough.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If the rest of us take four wins, we can 
still do it! That's exactly what this 
special training is for!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Look, I bought a whole bunch of different 
carrots! I even summarized all their 
characteristics in my notebook!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Shion-chan... You're right, we can't give 
up before we even try! —Let's do this! 
Special training!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... This taste and texture... are so 
similar to the previous one. Blindfolded, 
I might not be able to tell the 
difference—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Kh... What else makes the Kuroda Gosun 
unique...?!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
...Cooked carrots are really tricky. They 
might add honey to simmered carrots to 
manipulate the sweetness and throw us 
off...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's taste-test them prepared in every 
cooking method and seasoning we can think 
of!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Very little gaminess and sweet. Plus, a 
soft flesh texture. This carrot is... the 
"Kinbi Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Correct! That's a perfect score on all 
questions! We can win... With this, we can 
totally beat the Miho Dorm!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The four of us are gonna win this! 
And become the heroes of Ritto Dorm!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
One day while taking a break in the 
cafeteria, I was asked to referee an 
inter-dormitory match. Apparently, the 
event was a "blind carrot taste test."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's one win down! Come on, 
let's keep the momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The match kicked off with a victory for 
Ritto Dorm. However, taking the second and 
third matches was—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... *sniff sniff*... —I smell 
something. Plate A reeks of foul play.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If A is a deception, then "Dark Purple" is 
Plate B!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She can tell like that...?! Fenomeno-san 
turned out to be a total dark horse!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Now Miho has two wins and Ritto has 
one. If I win the next round, Miho takes 
the match~ Is my opponent Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
!! Sky-san is the fourth runner...? If I 
remember right, her family runs a farm, so 
she's undefeated in carrot tastings.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She's a formidable opponent... Still, I 
can't give up—!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—that proved to be quite an amusing 
sideshow. Allow me to bestow a reward upon 
you lot.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
The next representative for Ritto Dorm 
shall be me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: O... Orfe-san?! Y-You're representing us?!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice. I shall pique your interest once 
more. —Come, begin.
choice_data_list:
Fourth match: 'Guess the Grilled Carrot 
Variety', start!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Sweet? It has a fruity note too, so 
maybe 'Beni Kaori'?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
An ordinary gosun carrot—the 'Tokinashi 
Gosun'.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Detailed knowledge can sometimes breed 
preconceptions. Taste it properly, and the 
added sweetness from seasoning is obvious.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha... Seriously, Orfe-san... No 
matter where you go, you're always the 
main star, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about! It's only 
because we put up a good fight that 
Orfe-san was inspired to step up!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
All of Shion-san's hard work leading up to 
this point... everyone in Ritto Dorm knows 
full well!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. So—Captain! Go bring home that 
final victory!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y... Yes! I won't let everyone's hard work 
go to waste!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: And then, the final match concluded—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! We did it! We seized victory 
with the teamwork of Ritto Dorm!
